name: WMUIQrCode
description: Generates a QR code from any string, with an optional centered logo. Drawn as vectors, so it stays crisp at any size and renders identically on iOS, Android and web.

value.name: value
value.description: Text or URL to encode. Example: 'https://www.wavemaker.com'

size.name: size
size.description: Edge length of the rendered symbol in pixels. Default: 160

color.name: color
color.description: Color of the QR modules (the dark squares). Default: #000000

backgroundColor.name: backgroundColor
backgroundColor.description: Background drawn behind the symbol. Default: #FFFFFF

logoUrl.name: logoUrl
logoUrl.description: Optional logo image drawn at the center. Pair it with error correction Q or H so the code still scans.

logoSize.name: logoSize
logoSize.description: Logo edge length in pixels. Default: 40

errorCorrection.name: errorCorrection
errorCorrection.description: Error correction level. L tolerates the least damage and encodes the most data; H tolerates the most. Default: M

onError.name: onError
onError.description: Fires when the value cannot be encoded, for example when it is too long for the chosen error correction level.
